items.title: 第 1 题 · 一条指令＝操作码＋操作数
items.style: 等距微立体 3D，深靛蓝底，琥珀与青绿发光线条，金属磨砂质感
items.layout: A＝点菜场景｜B＝指令双段结构｜C＝两栏对照卡｜D＝结论条
items.prompt: Isometric 3D infographic, landscape, four-zone layout, deep indigo background with amber and cyan glowing lines, brushed-metal texture, soft shadows, clean and uncluttered. Zone A (left, about 60% width): a small isometric restaurant scene — a waiter stands beside a round table holding a menu pad, on the pad two rows of symbols are visible, the upper row shows cooking actions (a frying-pan icon, a whisk icon) and the lower row shows ingredients (an egg, a tomato, a mushroom); the table holds two finished dishes, a small bell and a folded napkin; a dotted arc connects the pad to the dishes. Zone B (upper right): a single long instruction bar split by a thin seam into two interlocking blocks — the left block carries action icons (plus, minus, multiply) inside a gear outline, the right block carries three stacked glowing data cubes with a small arrow entering; the bar slides into a dark chip slot beneath it. Zone C (lower right): a pale comparison card with two rows, each row an icon plus a short label, and a small green tick on each row; no crossed items. Zone D (bottom full-width bar): a dark rounded conclusion strip with a green check badge. Text on the image is Simplified Chinese only, appearing in five short labels: "操作码", "操作数", "指令", "做什么", "对谁做" — bold sans-serif on small white rounded plates, each label no more than three characters. 16:9 landscape, high resolution, clean background.

Zone B (upper right): a simple topology — a desktop computer on the left, a tall server rack on the right, connected by one bold double-headed arrow with an upward arrowhead labelled conceptually as sending and a downward arrowhead as receiving; a small globe sits behind the server. Zone C (lower right): a pale card with three rows of small icons (an envelope, a browser window, a chat bubble), each row struck through with a thin grey line. Zone D (bottom full-width bar): a light blue rounded conclusion strip with a green check badge. Text on the image is Simplified Chinese only, in three short labels: "文件", "上传", "下载" — bold sans-serif on white rounded plates, each label no more than three characters. 16:9 landscape, high resolution, clean background.

Zone D (bottom full-width bar): a warm rounded conclusion strip with a green check badge. Zone D (bottom full-width bar): an off-white rounded conclusion strip with a green check badge.
